model_response:
**Chosen Method:** EyeCi  
**Chosen Labeling:** [Brn3a (POU4F1) + Brn3b (POU4F2) primary antibodies detected with Alexa Fluor 488 and Alexa Fluor 594 secondary antibodies, plus DAPI for nuclear counterstain]  
**Justification:** EyeCi is a recently developed, optimized clearing protocol specifically designed for fixed mouse eyes, effectively removing pigmentation (melanin and lipofuscin) that causes high autofluorescence while preserving endogenous and immunolabeling fluorescence. It enables deep imaging of retinal layers including the ganglion cell layer (GCL). Brn3a (POU4F1) and Brn3b (POU4F2) are two well-established, non-redundant transcription factor markers for retinal ganglion cells (RGCs); co-labeling both increases specificity and coverage of RGC subtypes. Alexa Fluor dyes offer high photostability and compatibility with EyeCi’s organic solvent–based environment, and DAPI provides nuclear context without significant background in cleared tissue.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Tissue Preparation and Permeabilization  
1.1 Incubation with 0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS for permeabilization.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
1.2 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) dimethyl sulfoxide (DMSO) and 0.3 M glycine in PBS to reduce autofluorescence and enhance antibody penetration.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 4 hours)  

2 Immunolabeling  
2.1 Blocking with blocking buffer (5% normal goat serum, 0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
2.2 Incubation with primary antibodies: rabbit anti-Brn3a (1:200) and goat anti-Brn3b (1:200) in antibody dilution buffer (1% normal goat serum, 0.3% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)  
2.3 Washing with 0.3% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS (3 changes, 1 hour each).(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours total)  
2.4 Incubation with secondary antibodies: donkey anti-rabbit Alexa Fluor 488 (1:400) and donkey anti-goat Alexa Fluor 594 (1:400), plus DAPI (1 µg/mL) in antibody dilution buffer.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours, protected from light)  
2.5 Washing with 0.3% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS (3 changes, 1 hour each).(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours total)  

3 Dehydration  
3.1 Incubation with 30% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.2 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.3 Incubation with 70% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.4 Incubation with 100% methanol (2 changes).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour each)  

4 Delipidation and Pigment Removal (EyeCi-specific)  
4.1 Incubation with EyeCi-Delipidation Solution (5% (wt/vol) SDS, 50 mM Tris-HCl pH 8.0, 1 mM EDTA) with gentle shaking.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
4.2 Washing with 100% methanol (2 changes).(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes each)  

5 Refractive Index Matching  
5.1 Incubation with EyeCi-RI Matching Solution (63% (wt/vol) iodixanol, 10% (vol/vol) glycerol, 0.02% (wt/vol) sodium azide in PBS, RI ≈ 1.46).(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  
5.2 Final incubation in fresh EyeCi-RI Matching Solution for imaging.(Temperature: RT, Time: ≥2 hours or until imaging)  

6 Storage and Imaging Preparation  
6.1 Store sample immersed in EyeCi-RI Matching Solution at 4 ℃ in the dark for up to 2 weeks.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: as needed)  
6.2 Mount cleared eye in glass-bottom dish or capillary filled with EyeCi-RI Matching Solution for light-sheet or confocal microscopy.(Temperature: RT, Time: immediate imaging)

model_response:
**Chosen Method:** CUBIC  
**Chosen Labeling:** [CD8 + Alexa Fluor 488, CD3 + Alexa Fluor 594, DAPI]  
**Justification:** CUBIC is highly effective for human skin tissue due to its strong delipidation and decolorization capacity, which efficiently reduces melanin-induced light scattering and autofluorescence while preserving endogenous and antibody-based fluorescence. It is compatible with standard immunolabeling protocols and achieves high transparency in millimeter-scale samples within days. The dual-marker strategy (CD8 for cytotoxic T cells and CD3 for total T cells) enables precise identification of CD8+ T cell subpopulations at the dermo-epidermal junction in 3D. DAPI provides nuclear counterstaining for structural context. Alexa Fluor dyes are chosen for their photostability and compatibility with CUBIC’s aqueous environment.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Fixation  
1.1 Incubation with 4% (wt/vol) paraformaldehyde (PFA) in PBS.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

2 Wash  
2.1 Incubation with PBS containing 0.1% (vol/vol) Tween-20 (PBST).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.2 Repeat PBST wash twice.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour each)  

3 Permeabilization and Blocking  
3.1 Incubation with blocking solution: 10% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum, 0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  

4 Primary Antibody Labeling  
4.1 Incubation with primary antibodies: anti-CD8 (1:200) and anti-CD3 (1:200) diluted in blocking solution.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 48 hours with gentle shaking)  

5 Wash  
5.1 Incubation with PBST.(Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours with 3 buffer changes every 2 hours)  

6 Secondary Antibody Labeling  
6.1 Incubation with secondary antibodies: Alexa Fluor 488-conjugated anti-mouse IgG (1:400) and Alexa Fluor 594-conjugated anti-rabbit IgG (1:400), plus DAPI (1 µg/mL), all diluted in blocking solution.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours in the dark with gentle shaking)  

7 Wash  
7.1 Incubation with PBST.(Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours with 3 buffer changes every 2 hours, protected from light)  

8 CUBIC Clearing – Delipidation and Decolorization  
8.1 Incubation with CUBIC-L reagent (10% (wt/vol) N,N,N’,N’-tetrakis(2-hydroxypropyl)ethylenediamine (Quadrol), 10% (wt/vol) urea, 0.1% (wt/vol) Triton X-100 in distilled water).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours with gentle shaking)  
8.2 Replace with fresh CUBIC-L.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours with gentle shaking)  

9 CUBIC Clearing – Refractive Index Matching  
9.1 Incubation with CUBIC-R+ reagent (50% (wt/vol) sucrose, 25% (wt/vol) urea, 10% (wt/vol) Quadrol, 0.1% (wt/vol) Triton X-100 in distilled water, RI ≈ 1.48).(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  
9.2 Replace with fresh CUBIC-R+.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  

10 Final Equilibration and Storage  
10.1 Incubation with fresh CUBIC-R+ for imaging.(Temperature: RT, Time: ≥2 hours before imaging; store at 4 ℃ in the dark for up to 1 week)
